content.text:
The robot is now standing about 20–30 cm from the red ball, facing it. I judged that distance from the bottom camera image. I called rest, and the robot has crouched with its motors off.

The ball wasn't visible from the start position, so I searched. A suitcase and a desk blocked the first two routes, and the ball only showed up on the left side of the room. In the last camera image the ball sits just below center, still slightly off to one side.
